There is no direct U2 pin 34 node on DISP_SCL.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the intended display I2C clock is a direct net: DISP_SCL: U2 pin 34 (PB13) — R6 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pin 18 (D0), with no additional active component on the bus.

anomalies.impact: The board does not match the intended direct I2C SCL connection. The added buffer can break the clock line if the MCU uses open-drain I2C, because Net-(U5-Pad2) has no pull-up and the buffer input floats when PB13 releases the line; at minimum it is an undocumented change to the display bus behavior.
